section.title: Statement on USB transfer rate
section.p: Depending on many factors such as the processing capability of the host and peripheral devices, file attributes, and other factors related to system configuration and operating environments, the actual transfer rate using the various USB connectors on this device will vary and will be slower than the data rate listed in the connector name for each corresponding device.

section.title: Power indicator
section.p:
Shows the system status of your computer.
On: The computer is starting up or working.
Off: The computer is off or in hibernation mode.
Blinking slowly: The computer is in sleep mode.

section.title: Storage indicator
section.p: The storage indicator blinks when a storage drive is under reading or writing.

section.title: Always On USB feature
section.p: A USB connector with a battery icon an icon of a dry-cell cylindrical battery supports the Always On USB feature. With the Always On USB feature enabled, the connector can charge a USB-compatible device when the computer is in sleep mode (S3), in hibernate mode (S4), or even off (S5).

To enable the Always On USB feature, do the following:
Turn on or restart the computer. When the logo screen is displayed, press F1 or Fn+F1 to enter the UEFI BIOS menu.
Click DevicesUSB Setup USB Charging Port in S4/S5 to enable the Always On USB feature.
